comment: Recognition layer 2: communities/districts along the Airport→Ochi route. Coordinates are real OSM lat/lon, projected into world space via route origin+scale at runtime. radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters. needs_owner_review flags entries where the owner's lived knowledge should confirm placement or note text — map data is a starting point, not authoritative.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: End of the Palisadoes strip — the famous roundabout into Kingston

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Along Windward Road; home of the Rockfort Mineral Baths

communities.name: Rollington Town
communities.note: Residential community along Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston business district, Trafalgar and Hope Road area

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: At the entrance to the Rio Cobre gorge

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town — immortalised in the Linstead Market folk song

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Junction town in the St Ann hills

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside stop — jerk chicken, roast yam and festival

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Iconic canopy of bamboo and tree ferns over the road to Ocho Rios

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: North coast resort town — the journey ends here
